files.app.py:
import anthropic
from flask import Flask, request, session, jsonify
import config

app = Flask(__name__)
app.secret_key = config.SECRET_KEY
client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=config.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)


@app.post("/check")
def check():
    msg = client.messages.create(
        model=config.MODEL,
        max_tokens=config.MAX_REPLY_TOKENS,
        system="Review a beginner's Python exercise. Student email: " + session.get("student_email", ""),
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": request.json["code"]}],
    )
    return jsonify(review=msg.content[0].text)

from django.db import models


class ClassUsage(models.Model):

    day = models.DateField()
    tokens = models.IntegerField(default=0)

    class Meta:
        unique_together = ("class_code", "day")
files.tutor/views.py:
import datetime
import os

import anthropic
from django.http import JsonResponse
from django.shortcuts import render

from .models import ClassUsage

client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=os.environ["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"])
DAILY_CLASS_BUDGET = 300000


def ask(request):
    code = request.GET.get("code", "")
    usage, _ = ClassUsage.objects.get_or_create(class_code=code, day=datetime.date.today())
    if usage.tokens > DAILY_CLASS_BUDGET:
        return JsonResponse({"reply": "Class budget used up today."}, status=429)
    msg = client.messages.create(
        model="claude-3-5-haiku-latest",
        max_tokens=300,
        system="Help with homework. Explain steps, do not give final results.",
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": request.GET.get("q", "")}],
    )
    usage.tokens += msg.usage.input_tokens + msg.usage.output_tokens
    usage.save()
    return JsonResponse({"reply": msg.content[0].text})


def teacher_dashboard(request):
    return render(request, "teacher.html", {"rows": ClassUsage.objects.order_by("-day")[:30]})

files.api/chat.py:
import os
from collections import defaultdict
import anthropic
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException

client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=os.environ["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"])
app = FastAPI()
CALLS = defaultdict(int)
CLASS_TOKENS = defaultdict(int)
DAILY_CLASS_BUDGET = 300000


@app.post("/api/chat")
async def chat(body: dict):
    learner, cls = body["learner_id"], body["class_id"]
    CALLS[learner] += 1
    if CALLS[learner] > 12:
        raise HTTPException(429, "Please wait a moment.")
    if CLASS_TOKENS[cls] > DAILY_CLASS_BUDGET:
        raise HTTPException(429, "Class budget used up today.")
    msg = client.messages.create(
        model="claude-3-5-haiku-latest",
        max_tokens=300,
        system="You are a patient study buddy. Ask guiding questions.",
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": body["text"]}],
    )
    CLASS_TOKENS[cls] += msg.usage.input_tokens + msg.usage.output_tokens
    return {"reply": msg.content[0].text}


@app.get("/teacher/usage")
def teacher_usage():
    return dict(CLASS_TOKENS)
